posts.hook: The VPN box guarding thousands of corporate networks just got popped
posts.caption: citrix confirmed two netscaler zero-days are being actively exploited, microsoft's ai chief is calling for outside oversight before models get 10x bigger, and dhs says it'll use ai to handle foia redactions. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Citrix NetScaler zero-days are being exploited right now
slides.desc: Two critical RCE bugs, one scoring ==9.5==, hit every gateway by default

slides.title: Microsoft's AI chief wants oversight before models get 10x bigger
slides.desc: Suleyman is pushing for a cross-industry body to jointly evaluate frontier AI risk

slides.title: DHS will use AI to decide what your FOIA request gets to see

slides.desc: Enterprises are routing spend away from closed labs to cut costs
